blurb: Guests can enjoy private sailboat rides for up to six guests in the morning or at sunset on Barnegat Bay and Toms River. Brunch and dinner cruises feature homemade Jersey fare and spectacular sunsets. Sailing instruction and captain services are available for various skill levels and needs.
extraNote: Pay by cash or credit card on day of cruise · Notify at least 24 hours in advance to avoid charge for cancellation · Weather cancellations if NOAA forecast for severe or thunderstorms is 50% or more · Will call at least two hours before departure if weather requires cancellation or rescheduling · Departs from OGYB marina
